translationRepairs: When a bodyguard of Alana and slaves belonging to the Duke and Erke Daiqing clashed in the market, his ruling did not accord with the facts. He was convicted of deception, spared execution, and dismissed from office.

When the household slaves of Bodyguard Alana and of Duke Erke Daiqing fought in the market, his ruling did not accord with the facts. He was convicted of deception, spared execution, and dismissed from office.
Chinese 侍衛阿拉那與公額爾克戴青兩家奴 means the slaves of the two households of Bodyguard Alana and Duke Erke Daiqing, not a bodyguard of Alana and a separate Duke apart from Erke Daiqing.

When a bodyguard of Alana and slaves of the households of the Duke and Erke Daiqing fought in the market, his judgment did not match the facts; he was found guilty of deception, spared death, and stripped of office.

When the household slaves of Bodyguard Alana and of Duke Erke Daiqing fought in the market, his judgment did not match the facts; he was found guilty of deception, spared death, and stripped of office.
Same error as idiomatic: 公額爾克戴青 is one person (Duke Erke Daiqing); 兩家奴 are the slaves of Alana's and the duke's households.
